# Product context

**Biograph** (project name *fossibleHIS*, app name `healthcare`) is an open-source **Hospital Information System (HIS)** from Tacten / Fossible Works. It is a fork of *Marley Health* (earthians) with added features, and it is installed as a **Frappe app on top of ERPNext**. The data model is mostly based on **HL7 FHIR**.

## Who uses it
- **Clinical and front-office staff** at clinics and hospitals use the Frappe Desk UI (`/desk/healthcare`). Their workspaces are Healthcare, Outpatient, Inpatient, Diagnostics, Rehabilitation, Insurance and Setup.
- **Patients** use the Patient Portal SPA (`/patient-portal`). It lets them see appointments, book appointments, view diagnostics and prescriptions, and pay bills.
- **Administrators** configure Healthcare Settings, Service Units, Medical Departments and Medical Code Standards.

## Feature areas
- Patient management, including duplicate-patient checks
- Outpatient appointments, including block-based therapy booking
- Inpatient records and service-unit occupancy billing
- Clinical procedures, lab tests, observations and diagnostic reports
- Rehabilitation and physiotherapy (therapy plans and sessions)
- Medication requests
- Insurance (payors, contracts, coverage, claims)
- India ABDM integration (`healthcare/regional/india/abdm`)
- Fee validity and invoicing through ERPNext Sales Invoice and Payment Entry

Pharmacy, stock, HR, accounts and assets come from ERPNext. Do not reimplement them; integrate through ERPNext doctypes and `doc_events` instead.
